config.label: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of
config.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

config.label: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache
config.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

config.label: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1
config.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

config.label: Power-user override: any transformers
config.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

config.label: Embedding backend
config.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

config.label: Base URL of a local Ollama server
config.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

config.label: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama
config.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

config.label: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests
config.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Default 8192. Ollama's own default is 2048 which silently truncates long chunks for models trained on larger contexts (nomic-embed-text at 8192, bge-m3 at 8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b at 32 768). See https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008.

config.label: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher
config.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

config.label: Set to '1' to disable the startup catchup reindex that picks up edits made while the server was down
config.description: Set to '1' to disable the startup catchup reindex that picks up edits made while the server was down.

config.label: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds
config.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

config.label: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds
config.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

config.label: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

config.label: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens)
config.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

config.label: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides
config.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

config.label: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server
config.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.
